item.title: 澳門估算明年賭收2400億 花旗指當局預算保守中信里昂削目標價
item.description:
>
花旗與中信里昂對2027年澳門賭收前景看法現分歧。 澳門政府日前在《2027年財政年度預算案》中預計明年博彩毛收入(GGR)達2,400億澳門元，投行花旗與中信里昂證券(CLSA)對此看法明顯分歧。花旗認為當局預測一貫偏保守，日均賭收估算亦低於今年首10個月水平；中信里昂則指整體宏觀經濟因素仍未能提供足夠支持，預料賭收疲弱情況至少持續至2027年上半年，並進一步下調明年賭收預測及濠賭股目標價。 針對澳門政府提出2027年2,400億澳門元的賭收目標，花旗發表報告指出，該數字相當於日均賭收約6.58億澳門元，較2026年首10個月的日均水平低約4.5%，反映當局在編製財政預算時向來傾向採取審慎保守的態度。報告引述過往數據指，澳門政府於2024年底曾預測2025年賭收為2,400億澳門元，其後更一度下調至2,280億澳門元，但最終2025年實際賭收高達約2,470億澳門元。花旗強調，除疫情期間外，政府在絕大多數年份的賭收預測均低於最終實際數字。 與花旗相反，中信里昂對澳門博彩市場持審慎態度，進一步將2027年整體賭收預測下調8%至2,383億澳門元，較2025年實際水平低4%。該行分析師Jeffrey Kiang指出，中國上游產業毛利指標持續低迷且消費者信心指數停止復甦，顯示高端、中場及角子機市場均受壓；同時澳門每日博彩毛收入自2026年2月起由7.37億澳門元持續下滑至10月份的7億澳門元，除受宏觀與政策阻力拖累外，世界盃等競爭性活動亦分散了客源，目前唯一可確認的宏觀利好僅為人民幣兌港元及澳門元匯率略為走強。此外，隨着各博企的非博彩投資承諾將於明年陸續進入實際落實階段，2027年將成為博企資產負債表面臨考驗的一年，促使該行下調相關企業盈利預測。 受行業前景及盈利預測下調影響，里昂同步調整多隻濠賭股評級及目標價。其中澳博控股(880)評級由「持有」下調至「跑輸大市」，目標價由1.4港元大削逾五成至0.6港元；銀河娛樂(27)則仍為該行在行業內的唯一首選股，維持「跑贏大市」評級，其今年第三季淨現金相當於市值24%。

item.title: 司警首三季偵破379宗換錢黨案件 扣查逾2800萬涉案款項
item.description:
>
澳門立法會本周三舉行全體會議，辯論保安領域明年度施政方針政策。(澳門新聞局圖片) 澳門立法會本周三(25日)舉行全體會議，辯論保安領域明年度施政方針政策。會上聚焦維護國家安全教育及打擊不法匯兌等重點工作，保安範疇將牽頭編製未來五年國安教育總體規劃，而司法警察局今年首三季亦偵破近400宗「換錢黨」案件，持續與內地警方全鏈條打擊相關黑灰產業。 澳門保安司司長陳子勁引介明年施政工作時表示，保安範疇將貫徹總體國家安全觀，構建國安立體格局，並牽頭推進《澳門特別行政區全民國家安全教育總體規劃(2027-2032)》的編製工作。當局亦會持續創新「全民國家安全教育」系列活動內容，務求實現國安教育全覆蓋與長效化，築牢「維護國安，人人有責」的社會基石。此外，保安範疇將從不同切入點，採取多元方式宣揚非傳統安全，引導社會大眾加強對「看不見的安全」的認知與防範意識。 議員李良汪及周家俊關注打擊換錢黨問題，澳門司法警察局局長薛仲明在會上匯報最新執法成效。他指出，今年第一至三季，司警共偵破379宗涉及「換錢黨」的案件，拘捕482名涉案成員，行動中扣查現金及現金籌碼逾2,800萬港元，並成功查獲6間經營不法匯兌的店舖。 薛仲明強調，警方會持續密切監察不法匯兌的違法犯罪形勢，及時採取適應性警務策略。近年司警亦不斷深化與內地公安機關的合作，針對「換錢黨」幕後的黑灰產業實行全鏈條打擊，並已成功在內地瓦解多個地下錢莊及清洗黑錢的犯罪集團。

item.title: Major Banks Split on Macau’s 2027 Gaming Revenue Outlook: Citi Expects Conservative Budget, CLSA Turns Bearish and Cuts Target Prices
item.description:
>
Major Banks Split on Macau’s 2027 Gaming Revenue Outlook: Citi Expects Conservative Budget, CLSA Turns Bearish and Cuts Target Prices In its Fiscal Year 2027 Budget, the Macao SAR Government recently projected next year’s gross gaming revenue (GGR) at MOP 240 billion, drawing sharp divergence from two major international investment banks, Citi and CLSA. Citi views the government’s forecasts as consistently conservative, noting that the implied daily GGR estimate is below the level recorded in the first 10 months of this year. Conversely, CLSA states that overall macroeconomic factors have yet to provide sufficient support, expects gaming revenue weakness to persist at least through the first half of 2027, and has further lowered its 2027 GGR forecast as well as target prices for Macau gaming stocks. Regarding the Macao government’s 2027 GGR target of MOP 240 billion, Citi said in a report that the figure equates to daily GGR of roughly MOP 658 million, or about 4.5% below the daily average in the first 10 months of 2026, reflecting the authorities’ long-standing prudent and conservative approach when compiling fiscal budgets. Citing historical data, the report noted that in late 2024 the Macao government forecast 2025 GGR at MOP 240 billion and subsequently trimmed it to MOP 228 billion, whereas actual 2025 GGR reached approximately MOP 247 billion. Citi emphasized that outside of the pandemic period, government GGR forecasts have been below final actual figures in the vast majority of years. In contrast to Citi, CLSA took a cautious stance on the Macau gaming market, cutting its overall 2027 GGR forecast by a further 8% to MOP 238.3 billion (about US$29.5 billion), which is 4% below the actual level in 2025. CLSA analyst Jeffrey Kiang noted that persistently sluggish gross profit margin indicators in China’s upstream industries and a stalled recovery in consumer confidence indices point to pressure across the VIP/high-end, mass-market, and slot segments. Meanwhile, Macau’s daily GGR declined steadily from MOP 737 million in February 2026 to MOP 700 million in October, weighed down not only by macro and policy headwinds but also by competing events such as the World Cup diverting visitors, leaving slightly firmer RMB exchange rates against the Hong Kong dollar and Macao pataca as the only confirmed macro tailwind for now. In addition, as gaming operators’ non-gaming investment commitments gradually move into actual execution next year, 2027 will be a year of testing for operators’ balance sheets, prompting the bank to trim earnings forecasts for the relevant companies. Affected by the sector outlook and earnings forecast cuts, CLSA also adjusted its ratings and target prices across several Macau gaming stocks. Among them, SJM Holdings Limited (00880.HK) was downgraded from “Hold” to “Underperform,” with its target price slashed by more than 50% from HK$1.40 to HK$0.60. Galaxy Entertainment Group Limited (00027.HK), however, remained CLSA’s sole top pick in the sector with an “Outperform” rating, supported by net cash in the third quarter of this year equivalent to 24% of its market capitalization.

item.title: National Gymnasts to Perform in Macao Next Month
item.description:
>
Asian Games team and horizontal bar champion Tian Hao. To celebrate the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People’s Republic of China, the 27th anniversary of the establishment of the Macao Special Administrative Region (SAR), and the 10th anniversary of the Association of Macao Members of Provincial CPPCC Committees, the “National Gold Medal Athletes Visit Macao Series — Soaring Grace Gymnastics Gala x Walk for Vitality 2026” will take place from December 11 to 13. The event is co-organized by the Macao Cultural and Sports Bureau, the Association of Macao Members of Provincial CPPCC Committees, and the Sports & Olympic Committee of Macau, China, with support from multiple SAR government departments and sports associations, and title-sponsored by Galaxy Entertainment Group. As the highlight of the series, the “Soaring Grace Gymnastics Gala” will be staged on the evening of December 11 at the Macao Forum. Free tickets will be distributed to the public this Saturday (November 28) at the lobby of the Mong-Ha Sports Centre. Ding Xinyi, the rhythmic gymnastics team all-around champion at the Paris Olympics. The visiting Chinese gymnastics delegation boasts a star-studded lineup featuring numerous Olympic and world champions from the national artistic gymnastics, rhythmic gymnastics, and acrobatic gymnastics teams. The artistic gymnastics squad is led by Olympic champions Zou Jingyuan and Liu Yang, joined by Nagoya Asian Games champions Zhang Boheng, Tian Hao, Ke Qinqin, Du Siyu, and Zhang Yihan, alongside renowned athletes Qiu Qiyuan, Lan Xingyu, and Zhang Qingying. The rhythmic gymnastics team includes Paris Olympic champions Wang Lanjing and Ding Xinyi, as well as National Games champion Wang Zilu, while the acrobatic gymnastics squad is bolstered by World Championship gold-medal trio Li Jiaxin, Li Xiaozhen, and Chen Yutong. During the gala, these gold-medal athletes will perform alongside trainees from the Macau Gymnastics General Association and participate in interactive sessions to engage up close with local residents. The World Acrobatic Gymnastics Championships gold medal-winning team: Li Jiaxin, Li Xiaozhen, and Chen Yutong. The event series aims to share the achievements of China’s sports development, promote sports and cultural exchanges between the Mainland and Macao, and inspire local youth with the athletes’ spirit of perseverance. Residents interested in attending the gala can collect tickets free of charge on November 28 from 10:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. at the lobby of the Mong-Ha Sports Centre by presenting a valid identification document. Distribution is limited to two tickets per person on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last. All individuals aged two and above require a ticket for admission.

item.title: 國家體操金牌運動員下月訪澳獻技 大匯演門票周六免費派發
item.description:
>
亞運會團體、單槓冠軍田昊下月隨團訪澳獻技。 作為慶祝中華人民共和國成立77周年、澳門特區成立27周年及澳區省級政協委員聯誼會成立10周年的獻禮，由澳門文化體育局、澳區省級政協委員聯誼會及中國澳門體育暨奧林匹克委員會主辦，多個特區政府部門及體育總會協辦，銀河娛樂集團冠名贊助的「國家金牌運動員訪澳系列活動—騰風展藝體操大匯演 x 活力行2026」將於12月11日至13日舉行。其中重頭戲的體操大匯演定於12月11日晚上在澳門綜藝館上演，門票將於本周六(28日)在望廈體育館大堂公開免費派發。 巴黎奧運會藝術體操集體全能冠軍丁欣怡。 今次訪澳的中國體操代表團陣容鼎盛，匯聚國家體操隊、藝術體操隊及技巧隊多名奧運及世界冠軍。體操隊由奧運冠軍鄒敬園、劉洋領銜，聯同名古屋亞運冠軍張博恆、田昊、柯沁沁、杜思雨、張怡涵，以及邱祺緣、蘭星宇、張清穎等名將；藝術體操隊派出巴黎奧運冠軍王瀾靜、丁欣怡及全運會冠軍王子露等；技巧隊則有世錦賽金牌組合李佳欣、黎小禎及陳昱彤助陣。一眾金牌健兒當晚將與澳門體操總會學員同台獻技，現場亦設互動環節與市民近距離交流。 技巧世錦賽金牌組合李佳欣、黎小禎、陳昱彤。 今次系列活動旨在分享國家體育發展成果，推動兩地體育文化交流，並以運動員的拚搏精神激勵澳門青少年。有意索取大匯演門票的市民，可於11月28日上午10時至晚上8時前往望廈體育館大堂，憑有效身份證明文件免費領取，每人限領2張，數量有限，派完即止；年滿兩周歲或以上人士均需憑票進場。
